data.body: A4-3 no-change verification completed on origin/main b263218542. A4-1 landed evidence: Gerrit 1256 / commit 6cdd4b00d9ee, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1. Raw-vs-production filter plus positive controls: 3/3 passed (test_key_set_prev_field_drift_never_survives_the_production_filter, test_a_genuinely_new_remote_key_still_plans_its_inbound_create, test_seed_mutations_survive_the_suppression). Convergence controls: 3/3 passed (unchanged remote idempotency, byte/HEAD preservation, real remote field change converges). Live counter probe: positive_control=1, then empty production batch snapshot_head calls=0 and manifest mutation_count=0. Corpus: 4/4 real snapshot pairs, forward non-empty effect differences=0, reverse differences=0, unexpected inbound creates=0, max key-set bytes=16,297. The first parallel integration invocation passed its test body but teardown caught concurrent pytest cache creation; serial rerun with cacheprovider disabled passed cleanly. No source/test/docs files changed. Operator attestation: the proposed differ edit is intentionally not made because A4-1 load-bearing source/tests require suppression at the exceptional snapshot call site.
